redo_limit: Reached the maximum of {{max}} reworks without approval.
ask_limit: The agent asked follow-up questions the maximum of {{max}} times in this stage.
template_invalid: The output doesn't match the required template.
team_calls: The agent team used all its allowed calls.
team_tokens: The agent team used its whole token budget.
team_time: The agent team ran longer than allowed.
team_no_change: The agent team stopped improving the result after 2 consecutive calls.
job_timeout: The stage ran longer than allowed.
stage_tokens: The stage exceeded its token budget.
run_tokens: The run exceeded its token budget.
agent_failed: The agent failed while running this stage.
permission_lost: The person who started the run no longer has access to this agent or process.
user_inactive: The starter's account is locked or inactive.
interrupted: The stage was interrupted (the run was stopped or the system restarted).
source_unresolvable: Reference source could not be read
source_unresolvable_hint: A source (Git repository, path or document) could not be read at start. Ask an administrator to check it, then choose how to proceed.

apiError.REVIEW_TASK_CLOSED: Someone else already handled this item.
apiError.TASK_KIND_MISMATCH: This action doesn't apply to this item. Reload the page.
apiError.NO_OUTPUT: There is no output version to use yet.
apiError.NOT_PROCESS_DECIDER: You aren't allowed to decide this run.

back_limit: Reached the maximum of {{max}} go-backs without approval.

autofix.title: Autofix
autofix.big: Large diff: only the first 2,000 lines are shown, {{rest}} more. Download the .diff to see everything.
autofix.diffGone: The diff is no longer in storage (it was cleaned up). The check result is still valid.

noChanges.label: No changes
noChanges.hint: The agent changed no files, or the change matches the source. Choose "Not approved" to add a round.

loadErr.label: Could not load the diff
loadErr.hint: Check your connection and try again. You can still download the .diff file.

check.empty: No check report was received from the runner.

download.err: Could not download the file. Try again later.

autofix_check_failed: The change did not pass checks
autofix_check_failed_hint: No diff was saved. Add another round (the agent gets the error summary below) or cancel the process.
sandbox_unavailable_hint: The runner could not start an isolated container, so autofix cannot run. Contact your administrator, then add a round or cancel.

apply.title: Apply the fix
apply.rebasedHint: The default branch changed, so the fix was re-applied and the tests were run again before pushing.

auto.failedHint: The PR stays open and needs a manual merge. Check that the repo has "Allow auto-merge" on.

apply.pushedOnly: The source is set to "Branch only", so no PR was opened.
apply.localHint: A local path source is not pushed anywhere. Download the fix and apply it on your machine:
apply.noChangesHint: The fix matches the source, so there is nothing to push.

gate.pr: Passing will open a PR into {{base}}.
gate.auto_merge: Passing will open a PR into {{base}} and auto-merge when it is allowed.
gate.branch_only: Passing will push a branch to the repo without opening a PR.
gate.local: Passing only approves the fix. Download the .diff to apply it yourself.

apply.genericErr: The fix could not be applied. Retry or cancel.

err.auth: GitHub rejected the source credential (wrong, expired or lacking permission). Replace the credential on the Sources page, then retry.
err.no_credential: The source has no credential, so the branch cannot be pushed. Assign one on the Sources page, then retry.
err.push_rejected: GitHub refused the branch (protected or blocked). Retry or cancel.
err.network: Could not reach GitHub. Try again later.
err.rate_limited: GitHub is rate-limiting requests. Wait a few minutes, then retry.
err.provider_error: GitHub reported an error while opening the PR. Try again later.
err.check_failed: After merging with the latest code the fix did not pass the checks again (tests, paths, size or secrets). Run the process again on the new code, or cancel.
err.unsupported_provider: The source's git host does not support opening PRs. Change the source's apply mode to "Branch only".

apply_conflict: The fix conflicts with the new code
apply_conflict_hint: The default branch changed and the fix cannot be re-applied. To fix against the new code, run the process again. Adding a round only helps once the conflict is resolved in the repo.
